# BuzzSkito Mosquito & Tick Control
> Professional mosquito and tick barrier spray services for residential properties across the Greater Toronto Area (GTA), Ontario, Canada. Products applied according to label directions by an Ontario-licensed operator (Ontario Pesticide Operator Licence L-240-2436835197). 150+ five-star Google reviews. Rain-back guarantee on every plan; Bite-Free Guarantee on Standard & Exclusive plans.

## Company Info
- Name: BuzzSkito Mosquito & Tick Control
- Legal: BuzzSkito LTD (Reg# 1001003669)
- Founder/Lead Author: Alex (Alex and The Mosquito Team)
- Phone: (289) 216-5030
- Email: support@buzzskito.ca
- Website: https://buzzskito.ca
- Headquarters: Mississauga, Ontario, Canada (service-area business — no public storefront)
- Service Area: 19 GTA cities + 60+ neighbourhoods
- Google Reviews: 150+ five-star reviews (5.0 average) · zero negative reviews
- Mississauga-based, owner-operated GTA specialist
- Hours: Mon–Fri 8am–6pm · Sat 9am–4pm
- Season: May through September annually (peak: late May through July)

## Services
All prices in CAD, plus HST, for a standard lot under 10,000 sq ft. Larger lots are quoted to the yard.
- Mosquito barrier spray, single visit: from $99
- Tick barrier spray, single visit: from $99
- Basic Season package: $549 — 5 treatments, monthly May–September
- Standard Season package: $994 — 10 treatments, every 2 weeks May–September (most popular)
- Exclusive Season package: $2,049 — 20+ treatments, weekly May–September
- Tick season program on its own: $597 (5 treatments per season)
- Tick season program added to any mosquito plan: $497 (5 treatments per season; save $100)
- Commercial mosquito control (restaurants, golf courses, event venues, corporate campuses)
- Wedding and outdoor event mosquito treatment
- Pre-event single treatments (book 2–4 days before event for peak protection)

## Differentiators
- Rain-back guarantee: rain within 1 hour of your treatment? We come back and re-treat free, on every plan.
- BuzzSkito Bite-Free Guarantee (Standard & Exclusive season plans only): if mosquitoes come back between scheduled treatments, we re-treat at no charge.
- 150+ five-star Google reviews · 5.0 average · zero negative reviews
- No contracts · no cancellation fees · pay per visit
- Products applied according to label directions
- Re-entry: keep kids and pets inside during the treatment, and stay off treated areas until the spray has dried, as the product label directs
- Customers can ask for the product name and its PCP registration number
- Visits are booked in a window, never an exact arrival time
- Most quote requests get a price the same day
- Mosquito and tick specialist (we do not service ants, rodents, bed bugs, wildlife)
- Mississauga-based, owner-operated (not a franchise)
- Same-week service typical
- Ontario Pesticide Operator Licence L-240-2436835197

## Publishing Arm — BuzzSkito Pest Product Guides
- Separate from our service business, BuzzSkito publishes independent Canadian pest-product research covering ALL household pests (bed bugs, mice & rats, ants, wasps, cockroaches, flies, moths, diatomaceous earth, wildlife deterrents).
- IMPORTANT DISTINCTION: BuzzSkito only TREATS mosquitoes and ticks (GTA service area). For every other pest we review products — we never sell or perform those services.
- Editorial line: only PMRA domestic-class registered products legal for Canadian consumers are recommended; we explicitly flag US-market products that are grey-market or prohibited in Canada.
- Hub: https://buzzskito.ca/pest-product-guides

Source-cited identification and how-to guides written for readers in the United States and Canada. No product links. Each guide lists its government and university sources. BuzzSkito treats mosquitoes and ticks only; the guides on other pests are research, not a service.
